name: Shinohara Mio
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c60747]Yuusuke[/url]'s cousin Mio is a high school student that goes to the same school as him. She is a honor student who enjoys being a class representative. She's got a calm, relaxed type of personality. She likes putting up a facade of being a "good girl" while in secret she has a hidden side of hers that loves sex. Although Mio considers Yuusuke a mere plaything, she'll feel disturbed by the prospect of losing him from her grasp once [url=https://vndb.org/c59422]Misako[/url] moves in to Yuusuke's residence.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/921736-gibo-stepmothers-sin/faqs/31321]Geo's Walkthrough[/url]]
